neighbours.label: biblical 'increase' = harvest or produce (thine increase)
fire: The Lord shall prosper thee in all thine increase.
Honour the Lord with the firstfruits of all thine increase.
Then shall the earth yield her increase, and God shall bless us.
Thou shalt tithe all the increase of thy seed.
And he shall give the rain, and the ground shall give her increase.
Blessed be thy basket and all thine increase.
The land shall yield her increase, and the trees their fruit.
The vine shall give her fruit, and the ground her increase.
quiet: The Lord shall prosper thee in all thy works.
Honour the Lord with the firstfruits of all thy flocks.
Then shall the earth yield her fruit, and God shall bless us.
Thou shalt tithe all the grain of thy field.
Sales showed an increase of two percent in the third quarter.
The town saw a sharp increase in rents last year.
An increase in demand pushed the price of grain higher.
Doctors reported an increase in flu cases this winter.

notes: A narrow sub-trigger. The pole also fires on ' LDL' (0.21-0.33 in the probes, unstable), ' forces' and others; no shared pattern found.
